scales.name: Systemizing
scales.definition: Preference for deriving rules and structure over reading people and context, together with heightened sensitivity to detail and change.

facets.name: Detail and change sensitivity
facets.definition: Noticing alterations others miss; load from sensory input.

facets.name: Literality
facets.definition: Taking and giving language at face value.

bodyLinks.mechanism: Autistic traits are continuously distributed in the general population and highly heritable, but no clean neurotransmitter story exists. Saying so is part of the point.
bodyLinks.verification: Formal assessment for the clinical end; the trait itself is not confirmable by any biomarker.

items.text: I need to know how something works before I'm comfortable using it.
items.informantText: They need to know how something works before they're comfortable using it.

review.notes: Occupational confound: engineers and technicians self-select. Check DIF by occupation if collected.

items.text: I'm happy to use something without understanding it.
items.informantText: They're happy to use something without understanding it.

items.text: I look for the rule behind what people are doing.
items.informantText: They look for the rule behind what people are doing.

review.notes: Boundary case from the construct sheet: reading people *by* system counts as Systemizing, not as social skill. Cognitive interviews should confirm respondents hear it that way rather than as 'I understand people'.

items.text: Vague instructions don't bother me; I'll work it out as I go.
items.informantText: Vague instructions don't bother them; they'll work it out as they go.

items.text: I'd rather have an explicit procedure than be told to use my judgement.
items.informantText: They'd rather have an explicit procedure than be told to use their judgement.

items.text: I prefer to feel my way through a new situation rather than map it out.
items.informantText: They prefer to feel their way through a new situation rather than map it out.

items.text: I've taken something apart — physically or on paper — just to see how it was put together.
items.informantText: They've taken something apart — physically or on paper — just to see how it was put together.

items.text: How things work underneath holds no interest for me at all.
items.informantText: How things work underneath holds no interest for them at all.

items.text: I notice small changes to a room or a routine that others miss.
items.informantText: They notice small changes to a room or a routine that others miss.

items.text: Small changes to a room usually pass me by.
items.informantText: Small changes to a room usually pass them by.

review.notes: Reworded to remove a negation: agreeing with "I don't ..." makes the disagree side a double negative, which is a known source of respondent error. The pole and keying are unchanged; only the phrasing is now a positive assertion of the same thing.

items.text: Background noise or lighting affects me more than it seems to affect other people.
items.informantText: Background noise or lighting affects them more than it seems to affect other people.

review.notes: Boundary with sensory processing sensitivity and with A2: sensory load can be distress-driven. If the whole detail facet loads on A2 rather than A7, the facet belongs elsewhere.

items.text: Unannounced changes to a plan don't particularly affect me.
items.informantText: Unannounced changes to a plan don't particularly affect them.

items.text: A change to my routine I wasn't told about can throw off my whole day.
items.informantText: A change to their routine they weren't told about can throw off their whole day.

items.text: Busy, loud environments don't drain me.
items.informantText: Busy, loud environments don't drain them.

review.notes: Also an A4 boundary: this could read as sociability rather than sensory load. Watch the correlation with the A4 reward facet.

items.text: I've had to leave somewhere because the noise, light or crowding became unbearable.
items.informantText: They've had to leave somewhere because the noise, light or crowding became unbearable.

items.text: I can move between very different environments all day and feel much the same.
items.informantText: They can move between very different environments all day and feel much the same.

review.notes: Reworded to remove a negation: agreeing with "I don't ..." makes the disagree side a double negative, which is a known source of respondent error. The pole and keying are unchanged; only the phrasing is now a positive assertion of the same thing.

items.text: I read between the lines easily in conversation.
items.informantText: They read between the lines easily in conversation.

items.text: I answer the question people asked rather than the one they meant.
items.informantText: They answer the question people asked rather than the one they meant.

items.text: I pick up on hints without them being spelled out.
items.informantText: They pick up on hints without them being spelled out.

review.notes: High-context vs low-context communication cultures differ in how much is hinted at in the first place. DIF-test by locale.

items.text: People have told me I take things too literally.
items.informantText: People have told them they take things too literally.

items.text: I can tell when someone's being polite rather than sincere.
items.informantText: They can tell when someone's being polite rather than sincere.

items.text: I'd rather people said exactly what they wanted than implied it.
items.informantText: They'd rather people said exactly what they wanted than implied it.

review.notes: Directness preference overlaps A5 and varies by culture; same DIF concern as l03.

items.text: I've only realised a conversation was going badly when someone told me afterwards.
items.informantText: They've only realised a conversation was going badly when someone told them afterwards.

items.text: I read social situations quickly and accurately, almost without trying.
items.informantText: They read social situations quickly and accurately, almost without trying.

review.notes: High desirability, and the group most likely to under-endorse it is also the group most likely to have learned to camouflage. Camouflaging is learned and gendered, so self-report understates Systemizing in some respondents — a known limitation of every autistic-trait self-report measure, to be stated in the report copy.

citations.title: Autism traits dimensionality and multivariate relationship with alexithymia and anxiety in the general population
citations.claim: Autistic traits are continuously distributed through the general population rather than forming a discrete category.

citations.title: A comprehensive psychometric analysis of autism-spectrum quotient factor models using two large samples
citations.claim: The AQ's factor structure is unstable across samples; a reduced multi-factor solution performs best in both community and clinical data.
